Description: GSM module transmits data to Arduino (SoftwareSerial RX)
Arduino transmits AT commands to GSM module (SoftwareSerial TX)
Power supply (needs 3.4V-4.4V - use buck converter from 5V)
GPS module transmits NMEA data to Arduino (AltSoftSerial fixed RX pin)
Arduino sends commands to GPS module (AltSoftSerial fixed TX pin)
Power supply for LCD backlight and logic
Buzzer signal - HIGH to activate alert sound
Cancel button - press to cancel alert (uses internal pullup resistor)
Connected to ground (button press pulls pin LOW)
